disciplinary_grounds.description: Pleading guilty, nolo contendere, or being convicted of a felony, misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, sex offender crime, violent crime, Medicaid fraud, insurance fraud, identity theft, embezzlement, or controlled dangerous substances violation

definition_quote.value: The following acts by any person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of the State Dental Act
definition_quote.quote: The following acts by any person shall be regarded as practicing dentistry within the meaning of the State Dental Act

value: Representing oneself to the public as being a dentist or as one authorized to practice dentistry
Removing human teeth
Repairing or filling cavities in human teeth
Correcting or attempting to correct malposed teeth
Administering anesthetics, general or local
Treating deformities of the jaws and adjacent structures
Using x-ray and interpreting dental x-ray film
Removing stains, discolorations, or concretions from the teeth
Operating or prescribing for any disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity, or any physical condition connected with the human mouth
Taking impressions of the teeth and jaws
Furnishing, supplying, constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other substitutes for natural teeth
Adjusting any prosthetic denture, bridge, appliance, or other structure to be worn in the human mouth
Diagnosing, making, and adjusting appliances to artificial casts of malposed teeth
Writing a laboratory prescription to a dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician
Owning, maintaining, or operating an office for the practice of dentistry
methods_authorized.quote: Removing human teeth; Repairing or filling cavities in human teeth; Correcting or attempting to correct malposed teeth; Administering anesthetics, general or local; Treating deformities of the jaws and adjacent structures; Using x-ray and interpreting dental x-ray film
